title: The Hunger Games
author: Suzanne Collins
description: In a country that sends children to fight to the death on live television, Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her sister's place.
reasons: want a fast dystopian page-turner with a heroine who makes hard choices
are interested in how spectacle keeps people in line
want young adult fiction with real stakes
like survival stories with a political edge
dislikes: The present-tense narration takes a while to settle into
The love triangle is the weakest thread
World-building outside the arena is sketchy in this first book
